Name: Maggs Happy Birthday Content Pack
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!
Find out more about my coming Dragonsfall expansion on my website [url=https://www.maggplays.com]www.maggplays.com[/url]

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.
Updating: delete the old Maggs Happy Birthday Content Pack folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11148]Happy Birthday English Content Pack[/url], this mod will not work on its own.

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Overview[/size][/color][/b]
Customizes the Happy Birthday dialogue for these characters:
[list]
[*]Alex[/*]
[*]Sam[/*]
[*]Sebastian [/*]
[/list]﻿Adds content for these characters:
[list]
[*]Lance[/*]
[*]Dragonsfall OC characters (coming with the expansion mod)[/*]
[/list]I will add dialogue for any vanilla or SVE characters on request! Just leave a comment. Once I have a few requests, I'll add them and update this pack. 
NOTE: Characters from other expansions like Ridgeside, Sunberry, and East Scarp do not have open permissions, so I would need permission to add them.

I can't fully test every character, so if you see any issues, let me know in the comments.

In the screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41138]Magg's Sam Portraits and Sprites[/url], upcoming portraits for Lance, and upcoming Dragonsfall user interface.

[b]Special Thanks[/b]
Thanks to AziMinohi and MovingShadow13 for keeping me inspired to continue writing mods!
